spec_match.rationale: The before/after walkthrough of a handler rejecting with a structured error and the merchant catching it reads plausibly against the change, but nothing on the page executes — the error-object shape and catch behavior are asserted, not demonstrated, and carry no spec/source citations.

interactive.rationale: Zero interactive elements: five code blocks and a table. Rule 7 requires at least feature-detection plus a real invocation path (PaymentRequest is constructible without payment: a canMakePayment()/show() rehearsal with a data URL method, or at minimum a surface probe of the error plumbing).

blurb_alignment.rationale: 'Complete code walkthrough' is accurate, but the site's bar for a concept page is hands-on, and the index presents it alongside interactive siblings.

edge_cases.rationale: No feature detection, no unsupported state, no live error path — a browser without PaymentHandler renders identically to a supporting one.

references.rationale: Feature index carries the chromestatus link; the walkthrough itself cites no spec sections for the error-object contract it documents.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; this page anchors none of its claims to a probeable check.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: zero console errors, desktop clean, but 23px horizontal page overflow measured at 360×740 DPR3 — a real mobile-parity defect (side-by-side code grid / API table without min-width guards).

telemetry_health.rationale: No telemetry assert on the page.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables; inline pre styling matches stone-block idiom.

accessibility.rationale: Table labelled; but the before/after columns rely on position for meaning with h3 labels only — acceptable, minor.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 23px horizontal page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (measured); desktop 1280×2000 clean.

openQuestions.title: Fix the 23px mobile overflow
openQuestions.detail: At 360px the page scrolls horizontally (measured 23px). The code-pair grid columns and api-table need min-width:0 guards / an overflow-x wrapper so scrolling happens inside blocks, not the page body.

openQuestions.title: Add a live PaymentRequest error-path rehearsal
openQuestions.detail: Feature-detect PaymentRequest/PaymentHandler surfaces and drive a real error path where possible (e.g. constructing a PaymentRequest with an unsupported method and surfacing the real rejection), so the page demonstrates at least one genuine error contract instead of only quoting code.

guidanceConsulted.query: code walkthrough page add live probe rehearsal
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair documented API flows with at least one executable path.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: NOT applied by the page — filed as the major question.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): a static five-block code walkthrough with a real, measured 23px mobile overflow and no executable path or feature detection. Moderate layout fix and a major add-a-live-rehearsal question filed.
